d:
From the hit Bollywood movie De Dana Dan, this beautiful romantic song features Akshay Kumar and Katrina Kaif, whose on-screen chemistry makes this song truly unforgettable.
With soulful music and heartfelt emotions, Gale Lag Ja remains a favorite among Bollywood romance lovers. Presented by Ishtar Music, enjoy this classic love song with enhanced visuals and crystal-clear sound.
Watch, feel the love, and relive the romance!
Song : Gale Lag Ja Na Ja
Music : Pritam
Singer : Javed Ali & Banjyotsna
Lyrics : Ashish Pandit
Director: Priyadarshan
